charts.title: HD 73344 d: orbits around HD 73344
charts.description: The orbits of HD 73344's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 73344 d highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Zhang et al. 2025 (2025AJ....169..200Z), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname ZHANG_ET_AL_2025): P 5823 d
